shared_elements: upright slab/pillar surface carved in low relief
content divided into stacked horizontal registers
a distinct decorated band across the top
justification: Both are upright surfaces carved in shallow relief with content organised into stacked horizontal registers, a set-off decorated band at the top, and profile animal/bird forms rendered as outlined silhouettes. But the actual subjects differ fundamentally: A shows large isolated animals (a canine-like quadruped, a long-necked bird, snake-like forms) with no text or human actors, whereas B shows a winged disc over a scene of standing anthropomorphic figures facing one another above several rows of dense sign-writing.
